title: 土のうの積み上げ
description: 浸水対策として出入口や側溝の前に積む、ポリプロピレン製土のう12袋の三段積みです。枕状にふくらんだ袋の形、口を縛った紐の結び目、段ごとに半個ずらした積み方を造形しています。袋は単純化した形状で、織り目の質感、中の砂、変形の物理挙動、止水シートは含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.993 × 0.373 × 0.391 m、7,824三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A three-course stack of twelve polypropylene sandbags placed at doorways and gutters against flooding. It models pillow-shaped bags, tied neck knots and half-bag offset courses. Bags are simplified shapes without woven texture, contained sand, deformation physics or waterproof sheeting. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.993 × 0.373 × 0.391 m; 7,824 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
